title: ETSI baseline signatures and validation
description: What docs/playbooks/etsi-checklist.md marks as shown by a run: PAdES, CAdES and XAdES baseline signatures (EN 319 142-1, EN 319 122-1, EN 319 132-1), the extended forms, time-stamps, EN 319 102-1 validation and trusted lists, against the Sandbox, cross-validated with EU DSS when one is connected. Tags name the checklist items and the standards.

sections.title: PAdES baseline (EN 319 142-1)
sections.description: The four levels, then what a PDF signature adds: certification, incremental updates, PDF/A, the SubFilter, and the optional attributes.

steps.title: PADES B-B
steps.description: Signs the sample contract in PAdES B-B (ETSI.CAdES.detached, signing-certificate-v2, no time-stamp) and validates it right after: the baseline every other level builds on.

steps.title: PADES B-T
steps.description: PAdES B-T: B-B plus a signature time-stamp from the Sandbox's TSA, a proof the signature existed at that time.

steps.title: PADES B-LT
steps.description: PAdES B-LT: B-T plus the certificates, CRLs and OCSP responses in the DSS (and VRI), so the signature can be validated without fetching anything.

steps.title: PADES B-LTA
steps.description: PAdES B-LTA: B-LT plus a document time-stamp over the DSS, which keeps the validation data trustworthy after the certificates expire. Its file is validated at each validation level below.

steps.title: PAdES B-LTA with a separate archive TSA
steps.description: B-LTA with the document time-stamp taken from a TSA configured apart from the signature time-stamp's, as a preservation service with its own TSA would.

steps.title: Content appended after the signature
steps.description: An incremental update after the signature: the signed revision is intact; the report says what came after.

steps.title: Certification (DocMDP P=1)
steps.description: A certification signature with DocMDP P=1: no change at all is allowed after it.

steps.title: Certification (DocMDP P=2)
steps.description: Certification with DocMDP P=2: only filling form fields and signing are allowed afterwards.

steps.title: Certification (DocMDP P=3)
steps.description: Certification with DocMDP P=3: form filling, signing and annotations are allowed afterwards.

steps.title: Reason and location
steps.description: Writes the optional Reason and Location entries of the signature dictionary, to show they are kept and read back.

steps.title: Explicit signature policy (signature-policy-identifier)
steps.description: Writes an explicit signature-policy-identifier (OID, hash of the policy document, SPuri), as a policy-based signature (EN 319 142-1 'PAdES with policy') does.

steps.title: Preserve PDF/A
steps.description: Signs a PDF/A while preserving its conformance: the incremental update must not add anything PDF/A forbids.

steps.title: adbe.pkcs7.detached SubFilter
steps.description: The pre-PAdES SubFilter: still produced and read, but not a PAdES baseline signature.

sections.title: CAdES baseline (EN 319 122-1)
sections.description: Detached and attached content, the optional signed attributes, co-signatures and countersignatures, and the four levels.

steps.title: CADES B-B
steps.description: Signs the sample text in CAdES B-B (detached, signing-certificate-v2, signing-time) and validates it with the data. Its file is reused by the co-signature, the countersignature and the augmentation steps.

steps.title: CADES B-T
steps.description: CAdES B-T: B-B plus a signature time-stamp in the unsigned attributes. Its time-stamp is also checked against the EN 319 422 profile further down.

steps.title: CADES B-LT
steps.description: CAdES B-LT: B-T plus the certificates and revocation data needed to validate it offline, carried in the signature.

steps.title: CADES B-LTA
steps.description: CAdES B-LTA: B-LT plus an archive-time-stamp-v3 with its ATSHashIndex.

steps.title: CAdES B-B, attached content (p7m)
steps.description: CAdES B-B with the content inside the SignedData (a .p7m): the attached form, besides the detached one.

steps.title: Commitment type, signer location, roles, content hints, MIME type
steps.description: Writes the optional signed attributes: commitment type (proof of origin), signer location, signer role, content hints and the MIME type.

steps.title: Explicit signature policy (signature-policy-identifier, SPuri)
steps.description: Writes a signature-policy-identifier with only the policy OID and its SPuri (no document carried): the file va-policy-not-available validates.

steps.title: Signature policy with the policy document embedded (signature-policy-store)
steps.description: Writes the signature policy with its document embedded (signature-policy-store), so a validator can check it without fetching it: the file va-policy-available validates.

steps.title: Certified role (attribute certificate) and a signed SAML assertion
steps.description: Writes a signer-attributes-v2 with a certified role (an attribute certificate) and a signed SAML assertion, the two forms of claimed authority beyond a plain role.

steps.title: Content time-stamp before signing
steps.description: Time-stamps the content before signing (content-time-stamp attribute), proving the data existed before the signature, besides the signature time-stamp.

steps.title: Co-signature (a second, parallel signer)
steps.description: Adds a second, parallel signer (RSA 3072) to the CAdES B-B file: a SignedData with two SignerInfos over the same content.

steps.title: Countersignature of the first signer
steps.description: Countersigns the first signer of the CAdES B-B file with an ECDSA P-256 key: the countersignature signs the first signature value, not the content.

steps.title: Validate co-signers and a countersignature
steps.description: Validates a sample with co-signers and a countersignature: every signature in the tree must be found and verified.

sections.title: XAdES baseline (EN 319 132-1)
sections.description: Enveloped, enveloping and detached; the optional signed properties, the data-objects time-stamp, countersignatures and the four levels.

steps.title: XADES B-B
steps.description: Signs the sample XML order in XAdES B-B (enveloped, SigningCertificateV2, SigningTime) and validates it. Its file is countersigned and augmented below.

steps.title: XADES B-T
steps.description: XAdES B-T: B-B plus a SignatureTimeStamp.

steps.title: XADES B-LT
steps.description: XAdES B-LT: B-T plus CertificateValues and RevocationValues, so it can be validated offline.

steps.title: XADES B-LTA
steps.description: XAdES B-LTA: B-LT plus an ArchiveTimeStamp over the signature and its validation data.

steps.title: XAdES B-B, enveloping
steps.description: XAdES B-B enveloping: the XML document goes inside the signature's ds:Object.

steps.title: XAdES B-B, detached
steps.description: XAdES B-B detached: the signature references the document from outside and is validated with it.

steps.title: XAdES 1.3.2 SigningCertificate (V1)
steps.description: Writes the XAdES 1.3.2 SigningCertificate (V1, with IssuerSerial) instead of V2, for verifiers that only read the older property.

steps.title: Commitment type, roles, production place, data object format
steps.description: Writes the optional signed properties: CommitmentTypeIndication (proof of approval), SignerRoleV2, SignatureProductionPlaceV2 and DataObjectFormat (MIME type).

steps.title: Explicit signature policy (SignaturePolicyIdentifier)
steps.description: Writes a SignaturePolicyIdentifier with the policy OID and its SPURI qualifier (no document carried).

steps.title: SignaturePolicyStore with the policy document
steps.description: Writes a SignaturePolicyStore with the policy document, so a validator can check the policy without fetching it.

steps.title: SignerRoleV2 with a certified role and a signed SAML assertion
steps.description: Writes SignerRoleV2 with a certified role (an attribute certificate) and a signed SAML assertion.

steps.title: AllDataObjectsTimeStamp
steps.description: Adds an AllDataObjectsTimeStamp over the signed data, besides the signature time-stamp.

steps.title: CounterSignature
steps.description: Countersigns the XAdES B-B file with an ECDSA P-256 key (a CounterSignature unsigned property that signs the first SignatureValue).

steps.title: Inclusive canonicalization
steps.description: Signs using inclusive canonicalization (C14N 1.0) instead of exclusive, to show both are produced and verify.

sections.title: Keys and digests (all formats)
sections.description: Every format signs with each key type and digest the baseline profiles name (RSA 2048/4096, RSASSA-PSS, ECDSA P-256/P-384/P-521, SHA-256/384/512) and is validated right after; a weak key, a SHA-1 CA and a level that cannot be reached are refused.

steps.title: PADES with RSA-4096
steps.description: PAdES with an RSA 4096 key, validated right after.

steps.title: PADES with ECDSA-P256
steps.description: PAdES with ECDSA on P-256 (with SHA-256).

steps.title: PADES with ECDSA-P384
steps.description: PAdES with ECDSA on P-384 (with SHA-384).

steps.title: PADES with ECDSA-P521
steps.description: PAdES with ECDSA on P-521 (with SHA-512).

steps.title: CADES with RSA-4096
steps.description: CAdES with an RSA 4096 key.

steps.title: CADES with ECDSA-P256
steps.description: CAdES with ECDSA on P-256.

steps.title: CADES with ECDSA-P384
steps.description: CAdES with ECDSA on P-384.

steps.title: CADES with ECDSA-P521
steps.description: CAdES with ECDSA on P-521.

steps.title: XADES with RSA-4096
steps.description: XAdES with an RSA 4096 key.

steps.title: XADES with ECDSA-P256
steps.description: XAdES with ECDSA on P-256 (with SHA-256).

steps.title: XADES with ECDSA-P384
steps.description: XAdES with ECDSA on P-384.

steps.title: XADES with ECDSA-P521
steps.description: XAdES with ECDSA on P-521.

steps.title: PADES with RSASSA-PSS
steps.description: PAdES with RSASSA-PSS padding instead of PKCS#1 v1.5 (the RSASSA-PSS parameters written in the SignerInfo).

steps.title: CADES with RSASSA-PSS
steps.description: CAdES with RSASSA-PSS padding.

steps.title: XADES with RSASSA-PSS
steps.description: XAdES with RSASSA-PSS (the XML DSig 1.1 rsa-pss URI).

steps.title: PADES with SHA384
steps.description: PAdES with SHA-384 as the digest of the document and of the signed attributes.

steps.title: PADES with SHA512
steps.description: PAdES with SHA-512.

steps.title: CADES with SHA384
steps.description: CAdES with SHA-384.

steps.title: CADES with SHA512
steps.description: CAdES with SHA-512.

steps.title: XADES with SHA384
steps.description: XAdES with SHA-384 for the references and the signature.

steps.title: XADES with SHA512
steps.description: XAdES with SHA-512.

steps.title: RSA 1024 key: refused
steps.description: An RSA 1024 key, below what the default policy allows: refused before signing (KeyTooWeak).

steps.title: Chain with a CA signed with SHA-1: refused
steps.description: A certificate under a CA signed with SHA-1, with a signing policy that checks the algorithms of the CA certificates (playbook:strict-checks): SHA-1 in the chain is refused (AlgorithmNotPermitted).

steps.title: B-T with the TSA down: refused
steps.description: Asks for B-T while the TSA is down: the requested level cannot be reached, so the signer fails instead of silently returning B-B.

steps.title: B-T with the TSA down, lower level allowed: B-B
steps.description: Same, but the caller allows a lower level (returnLowerLevel): the signature is made at B-B and says it is not the level asked.

sections.title: Extended forms (EN 319 122-2, EN 319 132-2)
sections.description: The extended forms of EN 319 122-2 (CAdES) and EN 319 132-2 (XAdES) that predate the baseline levels: -C (references to the validation data), -X-L (the values too) and -A (archive time-stamp), for readers that still expect them.

steps.title: CADES -C (complete references)
steps.description: CAdES -C: a B-T signature plus complete-certificate-references and complete-revocation-references (references only, the values are not carried).

steps.title: CADES -X-L
steps.description: CAdES -X-L: -C plus the certificate and revocation values themselves.

steps.title: CADES -A (archive)
steps.description: CAdES -A: -X-L plus an archive time-stamp.

steps.title: XADES -C (complete references)
steps.description: XAdES -C: CompleteCertificateRefs and CompleteRevocationRefs after the signature time-stamp.

steps.title: XADES -X-L
steps.description: XAdES -X-L: -C plus CertificateValues and RevocationValues.

steps.title: XADES -A (archive)
steps.description: XAdES -A: -X-L plus an ArchiveTimeStamp.

sections.title: Augmentation (raising an existing signature's level)
sections.description: A B-B signature made above is raised one level at a time with the library's augmenters (PadesAugmenter, CadesAugmenter, XadesAugmenter); each result is validated. The PAdES B-LTA is then renewed with a new document time-stamp.

steps.title: PADES: augment to B-T
steps.description: Raises the PAdES B-B signature to B-T by adding a document time-stamp in an incremental update (EN 319 142-1 accepts it for level T), without signing again.

steps.title: PADES: augment to B-LT
steps.description: Raises the B-T file to B-LT by adding the DSS with the validation data.

steps.title: PADES: augment to B-LTA
steps.description: Raises the B-LT file to B-LTA with a document time-stamp over the DSS.

steps.title: PAdES: renew the archive time-stamp
steps.description: The validation data of the last document time-stamp, then a new document time-stamp over it.

steps.title: CADES: augment to B-T
steps.description: Raises the CAdES B-B signature to B-T by adding a signature time-stamp to the unsigned attributes (the detached data is given to rebuild the digest).

steps.title: CADES: augment to B-LT
steps.description: Raises the CAdES B-T file to B-LT by adding the certificate and revocation values.

steps.title: CADES: augment to B-LTA
steps.description: Raises the CAdES B-LT file to B-LTA with an archive-time-stamp-v3.

steps.title: XADES: augment to B-T
steps.description: Raises the XAdES B-B signature to B-T by adding a SignatureTimeStamp to the unsigned properties.

steps.title: XADES: augment to B-LT
steps.description: Raises the XAdES B-T file to B-LT with CertificateValues and RevocationValues.

steps.title: XADES: augment to B-LTA
steps.description: Raises the XAdES B-LT file to B-LTA with an ArchiveTimeStamp.

sections.title: Time-stamps (RFC 3161, EN 319 422)
sections.description: The signature time-stamp obtained while signing is checked before it is kept (token signature, trust, validity and revocation of the TSA, the TSA the signer expects), and a validation policy can require the EN 319 422 time-stamp profile.

steps.title: Token with an invalid signature: refused
steps.description: The TSA answers a token whose signature does not verify: the signer must detect it and refuse instead of embedding it.

steps.title: TSA certificate revoked: refused
steps.description: With a signing policy that checks the TSA (playbook:strict-checks), a TSA whose certificate is revoked: its token is refused (TimestampCertificateRevoked).

steps.title: TSA certificate expired: refused
steps.description: A TSA whose certificate has expired: its token is refused (TimestampCertificateNotValid).

steps.title: TSA outside the anchors: refused
steps.description: A TSA that chains to no anchor: its token is refused (TimestampUntrusted).

steps.title: Expected TSA
steps.description: Names the Sandbox's TSA as the expected one (expectedTsa): the token comes from it, so the signature is made.

steps.title: Another TSA than expected: refused
steps.description: Expects another TSA than the one that answers: refused (TimestampUntrusted), so a token from an authority the signer did not choose is never embedded.

steps.title: Time-stamp with the EN 319 422 profile
steps.description: The Sandbox TSA gives its accuracy, does not claim ordering and uses the policy the validation policy accepts.

steps.title: Time-stamp without accuracy, under the EN 319 422 profile
steps.description: The time-stamp fails AccuracyPresent, so it is not used as a proof of existence (EN 319 102-1); the signature itself, with a valid certificate, still passes.

steps.title: Authenticated TSA (HTTP Basic)
steps.description: Gets the time-stamp from the TSA endpoint that requires HTTP Basic authentication.

sections.title: Validation (EN 319 102-1)
sections.description: Each case must give its indication and sub-indication. Files come from samples or from the signing steps above.

steps.title: Intact PAdES
steps.description: Validates the intact PAdES sample: TOTAL_PASSED, and the ETSI TS 119 102-2 report must be valid against its XML schema.

steps.title: Intact CAdES (detached)
steps.description: Validates an intact detached CAdES sample with its data: TOTAL_PASSED.

steps.title: Intact XAdES
steps.description: Validates an intact XAdES sample: TOTAL_PASSED.

steps.title: PDF content changed
steps.description: Validates the PDF whose content changed after signing: the ByteRange digest does not match, TOTAL_FAILED / HASH_FAILURE.

steps.title: CAdES data changed
steps.description: Validates a detached CAdES signature against data that changed: TOTAL_FAILED / HASH_FAILURE.

steps.title: XAdES document changed
steps.description: Validates an XAdES file whose signed document changed: a reference digest fails, TOTAL_FAILED / HASH_FAILURE.

steps.title: PDF signature value changed
steps.description: Validates the PDF whose signature value was changed: digests match but the signature does not verify, TOTAL_FAILED / SIG_CRYPTO_FAILURE.

steps.title: CAdES signature value changed
steps.description: Validates a CAdES signature whose value was changed: SIG_CRYPTO_FAILURE.

steps.title: XAdES signature value changed
steps.description: Validates an XAdES signature whose SignatureValue was changed: SIG_CRYPTO_FAILURE.

steps.title: Root outside the anchors
steps.description: Validates the sample whose chain ends at a root outside the anchors: INDETERMINATE / NO_CERTIFICATE_CHAIN_FOUND.

steps.title: Signer revoked, no POE before it
steps.description: Validates the sample signed by a revoked certificate, without a time-stamp before the revocation: INDETERMINATE / REVOKED_NO_POE, and the ETSI report must still be schema-valid.

steps.title: B-T signature, then its signer is revoked
steps.description: Signs at B-T with the RSA 3072 certificate: the signature time-stamp is the proof of existence the next step relies on when it revokes the certificate.

steps.title: Revoked after the signature time-stamp
steps.description: The signature time-stamp is a proof of existence before the revocation: the signature stays valid.

steps.title: B-LTA by a signer valid for 20 seconds
steps.description: Signs at B-LTA with a certificate the Sandbox issues valid for 20 seconds, so the next step can validate it after the certificate has expired.

steps.title: Signer expired after a valid B-LTA
steps.description: Validated after the signer's certificate expired: the signature time-stamp proves the signature existed while it was valid.

steps.title: Signer under a revoked CA: refused before signing
steps.description: With the strict signing policy, a signer under a revoked CA: the chain's revocation is checked before signing, so it is refused (CertificateRevoked).

steps.title: Signer expired, no POE
steps.description: Validates the sample signed by an expired certificate with no proof of existence: INDETERMINATE / OUT_OF_BOUNDS_NO_POE.

steps.title: Signer not yet valid: refused before signing
steps.description: A certificate whose notBefore is in the future: refused before signing (CertificateNotCurrentlyValid), so no such file can be produced.

steps.title: Revocation status unknown (OCSP and CRL down)
steps.description: Validates the PAdES B-B file while the Sandbox's OCSP and CRL are both down: the status cannot be established, so INDETERMINATE instead of valid.

steps.title: Content time-stamp later than the signature time-stamp
steps.description: Out-of-order time-stamps are a constraint of the validation policy (Timestamp/Coherence): the default only warns, the strict preset fails.

steps.title: signing-certificate-v2 names another certificate
steps.description: Validates a CAdES sample whose signing-certificate-v2 points to a certificate other than the signer's: the signer cannot be identified, NO_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE_FOUND.

steps.title: Signature policy whose document is not available
steps.description: The signature names a policy but does not carry its document, and the validator has no way to obtain it: under a policy that requires it (PolicyAvailable FAIL).

steps.title: Signature policy carried in the signature-policy-store
steps.description: Validates the cades-policy-store file with the strict policy: the policy document travels in the signature-policy-store, so it can be checked and the signature is valid.

steps.title: Detached CAdES validated without its data
steps.description: Validates a detached CAdES signature without giving its data: nothing to compare the digest with, SIGNED_DATA_NOT_FOUND.

steps.title: Detached XAdES validated without its data
steps.description: Validates a detached XAdES signature without its document: SIGNED_DATA_NOT_FOUND.

steps.title: RSA 1024 signature (minimal signing policy, to validate)
steps.description: Signs with an RSA 1024 key under the minimal signing policy (which does not check key size), only to produce the file va-weak-key validates.

steps.title: RSA 1024 against the crypto suite
steps.description: Validates the RSA 1024 file: the cryptographic constraints of the validation policy reject the key size, so INDETERMINATE rather than valid.

steps.title: Signer with neither digitalSignature nor nonRepudiation (minimal signing policy, to validate)
steps.description: Signs with a certificate that has neither digitalSignature nor nonRepudiation under the minimal signing policy, only to produce the file va-key-usage validates.

steps.title: Signer with neither digitalSignature nor nonRepudiation
steps.description: The key usage a signer needs is a constraint of the validation policy (EN 319 102-1): this one (playbook:requires-key-usage) asks for digitalSignature or nonRepudiation.

steps.title: PAdES B-T: signer valid 40 s, TSA certificate valid 30 s
steps.description: PAdES B-T by a signer valid for 40 seconds, time-stamped by a TSA whose certificate is valid for 30: both will expire, to show past signature validation.

steps.title: PAdES: archived at once with the long-lived TSA
steps.description: Raises that file to B-LTA at once with the long-lived TSA: the archive time-stamp proves the signature and its time-stamp existed while their certificates were valid.

steps.title: PAdES: signer and signature TSA expired, archive time-stamp valid
steps.description: Past signature validation (EN 319 102-1 §5.6): the archive time-stamp proves the signature time-stamp existed while its TSA's certificate was valid, and that time-stamp proves the signature existed while the signer's was.

steps.title: CAdES B-T: signer valid 40 s, TSA certificate valid 30 s
steps.description: CAdES B-T by a signer valid for 40 seconds with a TSA certificate valid for 30, for the same past-signature case in CAdES.

steps.title: CAdES: archived at once with the long-lived TSA
steps.description: Raises the CAdES file to B-LTA at once with the long-lived TSA.

steps.title: CAdES: signer and signature TSA expired, archive time-stamp valid
steps.description: Past signature validation (EN 319 102-1 §5.6): the archive time-stamp proves the signature time-stamp existed while its TSA's certificate was valid, and that time-stamp proves the signature existed while the signer's was.

steps.title: B-T only: signer valid 40 s, TSA certificate valid 30 s
steps.description: The same short-lived PAdES B-T, but never archived: the control case for va-pastsig-no-archive.

steps.title: Signer and TSA expired, no archive time-stamp
steps.description: Nothing proves the signature time-stamp existed while its TSA's certificate was valid: no proof of existence.

steps.title: B-LTA validated at level BasicSignatures
steps.description: Validates the PAdES B-LTA file at the BasicSignatures level of EN 319 102-1: signature, chain and revocation only.

steps.title: B-LTA validated at level Timestamps
steps.description: Validates it at the Timestamps level: the signature time-stamp is used as proof of existence too.

steps.title: B-LTA validated at level LongTermData
steps.description: Validates it at the LongTermData level: the validation data embedded in the file is used.

steps.title: B-LTA validated at level ArchivalData
steps.description: Validates it at the ArchivalData level: the archive (document) time-stamp and past signature validation too.

steps.title: Signer without nonRepudiation (to validate)
steps.description: Signs with a certificate that has digitalSignature but not nonRepudiation (accepted by the default signing policy), to produce the file va-policy validates.

steps.title: A validation policy that requires nonRepudiation
steps.description: Validates that file with a validation policy that requires nonRepudiation in the signing certificate's key usage: the constraint fails, INDETERMINATE.

sections.title: Trusted lists (TS 119 612)
sections.description: Anchors taken from a TS 119 612 trusted list: a list that is expired, signed by another key or changed gives none; a service withdrawn after a time-stamp still vouches for that signature through the list's service history.

steps.title: Anchors from the Sandbox's trusted list
steps.description: Signs with the anchors read from the Sandbox's trusted list (its signature checked against the operator's certificate) instead of a configured root.

steps.title: Trusted list expired: refused
steps.description: The trusted list is past its NextUpdate: it gives no anchors, so signing is refused (UntrustedRoot).

steps.title: Trusted list signed by another key: refused
steps.description: The trusted list is signed by a key other than its operator's: no anchors, signing refused.

steps.title: Trusted list tampered: refused
steps.description: The trusted list changed after it was signed: its XML signature breaks, no anchors, signing refused.

steps.title: Validate with anchors from the trusted list
steps.description: Validates the tl-ok file with the anchors from the trusted list: valid.

steps.title: Validate with a fake trusted list
steps.description: Validates the same file while the list has another signer: no trusted anchors, INDETERMINATE.

steps.title: PAdES B-T while the root CA's service is granted
steps.description: Signs PAdES B-T while the list grants the root CA's service: the time-stamp is the proof of existence for the withdrawal step that follows.

steps.title: PAdES: service withdrawn after the signature time-stamp
steps.description: The trusted list now says withdrawn, with granted in the service history before: the anchors at the time-stamp's time vouch for the signature.

steps.title: XAdES B-T while the root CA's service is granted
steps.description: Signs XAdES B-T while the root CA's service is granted, for the same withdrawal check in XAdES.

steps.title: XAdES: service withdrawn after the signature time-stamp
steps.description: The trusted list now says withdrawn, with granted in the service history before: the anchors at the time-stamp's time vouch for the signature.

steps.title: Signing after the service was withdrawn: refused
steps.description: A signing policy that asks for a chain to the anchors: the root CA's service is withdrawn now.
